[SWS_CRYPT_20901] CRL and CTL usage
⌈
The X.509 Provider shall
support CRL and CTL. The format of CRL and CTL are defined in [32, RFC 5280], [43,
RFC 6518], [44, RFC 8398], and [45, RFC 8399] and is not part of this standard. The
X.509 Provider can store the CRL and the CTL in an own internal used structure.
However, the X.509 Provider can also use the provided information to update the
corresponding elements.
The update can be either the deletion of the element or
setting a mark that the element was revoked.
⌋
